issues.detail: The Greek 'απολογουμεθα' (apologoumetha) means 'giving an account' or 'giving a defense/explanation.' The Vietnamese translation 'tự bào chữa' (self-defending/justifying oneself) implies a defensive posture against an accusation, whereas the Greek refers to the act of giving an account of one's ministry/actions.

The Greek 'απολογουμεθα κατενωπιον του θεου' means 'we give an account before God.' The Vietnamese translation 'bào chữa trước mặt anh em' (defending ourselves before you/the brothers) changes the audience of the account from God to the brothers.
